Planning popcorn ceiling removal in Burlington? Homes in Palmer and Tansley, including properties near Upper Middle Road, often have textured ceilings continuing from family rooms into kitchens, hallways, or stair openings. When those connected surfaces receive strong daylight or new pot lights, painted texture, old fixture patches, tape lines, and uneven transitions can become more noticeable.

EPF Pro Services starts by reviewing the ceiling condition and choosing controlled removal or encapsulation where appropriate. Floors, walls, furniture, vents, cabinetry, and lighting are protected before drywall repairs and broad skim coating begin. HEPA-connected sanding, primer, and optional flat ceiling paint help prepare a consistent finish. Stair openings and connected rooms require careful access planning and directional-light checks because shadows can reveal ridges that ordinary room lighting misses.
